verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's own registered agent service gives founders state forms pre-filled with the provider's registered agent address. That puts the provider's address on state filings in place of the founder's own (docs-21), and the agent receives service of process on the founder's behalf (docs-19). The privacy benefit of keeping a home address off the public record is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the service keeps the founder's home address off public filings, clarity on whether the provider's address can also serve as the principal or mailing address, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
